# ---- Master/PartsStock combined grid builder — inline runPrepQuery (Order/Size pattern) ----
	# Executes the canonical PartsStock/list SQL from master-crud-namedqueries.sql via
	# system.db.runPrepQuery. IG81-COMPAT: plain parameterized T-SQL; identical on 8.1.52 and 8.3.
	log = system.util.getLogger("SPIKE")
	DB = "Inventory_Spike"
	parts = unicode(value).split("|")
	searchTerm = parts[0]
	siteId = int(float(parts[1]))   # IG-SITE: plumbed view->query; predicate still commented (D1)

	sql = "SELECT  p.IN_PART_ID AS RecordID, p.VC_PART_NUMBER AS PartNumber, p.VC_PARTS_NAME AS PartsName,         sup.VC_SUPPLIER_CODE AS SupplierCode, lg.VC_LOGISTICS_NAME AS LogisticsName,         sz.VC_SIZE_CODE AS SizeCode, rb.VC_RENBAN_GROUP_CODE AS RenbanCode, pt.VC_PART_TYPE AS PartType,         p.VC_LINE_NAME AS LineName, p.IN_QTY AS Qty FROM    INV_PARTS_STOCK_MST p         LEFT OUTER JOIN INV_SUPPLIER_MST sup ON p.IN_SUPPLIER_ID = sup.IN_SUPPLIER_ID         LEFT OUTER JOIN INV_LOGISTICS_MST lg ON p.IN_LOGISTICS_ID = lg.IN_LOGISTICS_ID         LEFT OUTER JOIN INV_SIZE_MST sz ON p.IN_SIZE_ID = sz.IN_SIZE_ID         LEFT OUTER JOIN INV_RENBAN_GROUP_MST rb ON p.IN_RENBAN_ID = rb.IN_RENBAN_ID         LEFT OUTER JOIN INV_PART_TYPE_MST pt ON p.IN_PART_TYPE_ID = pt.IN_PART_TYPE_ID WHERE  (? = '' OR p.VC_PART_NUMBER LIKE '%' + ? + '%' OR p.VC_PARTS_NAME LIKE '%' + ? + '%') -- IG-SITE:  AND p.site_id = ? ORDER BY p.VC_PART_NUMBER"
	ds = system.db.runPrepQuery(sql, [searchTerm, searchTerm, searchTerm], DB)
	log.info("SPIKE PartsStock/list: %d rows (search='%s' site=%d)" % (ds.rowCount, searchTerm, siteId))

	columns = [
		{"field": "PartNumber",   "header": {"title": "Part Number"}, "strictWidth": 130, "sort": "ascending"},
		{"field": "PartsName",    "header": {"title": "Parts Name"}},
		{"field": "SupplierCode", "header": {"title": "Supplier"}, "strictWidth": 90},
		{"field": "LogisticsName","header": {"title": "Logistics"}, "strictWidth": 100},
		{"field": "SizeCode",     "header": {"title": "Size"}, "strictWidth": 80},
		{"field": "RenbanCode",   "header": {"title": "Renban"}, "strictWidth": 90},
		{"field": "PartType",     "header": {"title": "Type"}, "strictWidth": 80},
		{"field": "LineName",     "header": {"title": "Line"}, "strictWidth": 100},
		{"field": "Qty",          "header": {"title": "On-Hand"}, "strictWidth": 90},
		{"field": "RecordID",     "header": {"title": "id"}, "visible": False}
	]
	rows = []
	for r in xrange(ds.rowCount):
		rows.append({
			"RecordID": ds.getValueAt(r, "RecordID"), "PartNumber": ds.getValueAt(r, "PartNumber"),
			"PartsName": ds.getValueAt(r, "PartsName"), "SupplierCode": ds.getValueAt(r, "SupplierCode"),
			"LogisticsName": ds.getValueAt(r, "LogisticsName"), "SizeCode": ds.getValueAt(r, "SizeCode"),
			"RenbanCode": ds.getValueAt(r, "RenbanCode"), "PartType": ds.getValueAt(r, "PartType"),
			"LineName": ds.getValueAt(r, "LineName"), "Qty": ds.getValueAt(r, "Qty")
		})
	return {"data": rows, "columns": columns}

onChange.script:
# ---- PartsStock combined view: recordId change -> load detail ----
	# Grid onRowClick sets self.view.custom.recordId = event.value["RecordID"] (same-view
	# prop write, NO navigation). This onChange fires on that write and populates the
	# in-view form. recordId==0 -> insert mode. IG81-COMPAT: plain change script + T-SQL.
	log = system.util.getLogger("SPIKE")
	v = self.view if hasattr(self, "view") else self
	DB = "Inventory_Spike"
	c = v.custom
	cv = getattr(currentValue, "value", currentValue)
	recId = int(cv or 0)
	log.info("SPIKE PartsStock Detail recordId onChange fired: recId=%s origin=%s" % (recId, origin))
	siteId = int(c.siteId or 1)   # IG-SITE: plumbed; predicate commented (D1)

	# ---- FK combo options (5 master lookups + the cross-DB Line list) ----
	def opts(sql):
		ds = system.db.runPrepQuery(sql, [], DB)
		return [{"value": ds.getValueAt(i, "id"), "label": ds.getValueAt(i, "label")} for i in xrange(ds.rowCount)]
	c.supplierOptions = opts("SELECT IN_SUPPLIER_ID AS id, VC_SUPPLIER_CODE AS label FROM INV_SUPPLIER_MST /* IG-SITE: WHERE site_id = ? */ ORDER BY VC_SUPPLIER_CODE")
	c.logisticsOptions = opts("SELECT IN_LOGISTICS_ID AS id, VC_LOGISTICS_NAME AS label FROM INV_LOGISTICS_MST /* IG-SITE: WHERE site_id = ? */ ORDER BY VC_LOGISTICS_NAME")
	c.sizeOptions = opts("SELECT IN_SIZE_ID AS id, VC_SIZE_CODE AS label FROM INV_SIZE_MST WHERE VC_SIZE_CODE <> '' /* IG-SITE: AND site_id = ? */ ORDER BY VC_SIZE_CODE")
	c.renbanOptions = opts("SELECT IN_RENBAN_ID AS id, VC_RENBAN_GROUP_CODE AS label FROM INV_RENBAN_GROUP_MST /* IG-SITE: WHERE site_id = ? */ ORDER BY VC_RENBAN_GROUP_CODE")
	c.partTypeOptions = opts("SELECT IN_PART_TYPE_ID AS id, VC_PART_TYPE AS label FROM INV_PART_TYPE_MST /* IG-SITE: WHERE site_id = ? */ ORDER BY VC_PART_TYPE")
	# Line: cross-DB 3-part name over Inventory_Spike (faithful spike equivalent of the ALC_Connection->VehicleOrder read)
	c.lineOptions = opts("SELECT DISTINCT LineName AS id, LineName AS label FROM VehicleOrder.dbo.LINE ORDER BY LineName")
	log.info("SPIKE PartsStock Detail combos: sup=%d log=%d size=%d renban=%d type=%d line=%d" % (len(c.supplierOptions), len(c.logisticsOptions), len(c.sizeOptions), len(c.renbanOptions), len(c.partTypeOptions), len(c.lineOptions)))

	if recId <= 0:
		c.statusMsg = "New part — enter details and Save."
		log.info("SPIKE PartsStock Detail: insert mode (recordId=0)")
		return

	getSql = ("SELECT p.VC_PART_NUMBER, p.VC_PARTS_NAME, p.IN_SUPPLIER_ID, p.IN_LOGISTICS_ID, p.IN_SIZE_ID, "
	          "p.IN_RENBAN_ID, p.IN_PART_TYPE_ID, p.VC_LINE_NAME, p.VC_KANBAN_NUMBER, p.IN_1LOTQTY, "
	          "p.BIT_LOT_SIZE_ORDERS, p.IN_RENBAN_COUNT, p.IN_QTY, "
	          "p.IN_LEADTIME, p.IN_LEADTIME_MONDAY, p.IN_LEADTIME_TUESDAY, p.IN_LEADTIME_WEDNESDAY, "
	          "p.IN_LEADTIME_THURSDAY, p.IN_LEADTIME_FRIDAY, p.IN_LEADTIME_SATURDAY, "
	          "p.IN_SHIP_DAYS, p.IN_SHIP_DAYS_MONDAY, p.IN_SHIP_DAYS_TUESDAY, p.IN_SHIP_DAYS_WEDNESDAY, "
	          "p.IN_SHIP_DAYS_THURSDAY, p.IN_SHIP_DAYS_FRIDAY, p.IN_SHIP_DAYS_SATURDAY, "
	          "p.MO_PART_COST, p.VC_COMMENTS "
	          "FROM INV_PARTS_STOCK_MST p WHERE p.IN_PART_ID = ? -- IG-SITE: AND p.site_id = ?")
	ds = system.db.runPrepQuery(getSql, [recId], DB)
	if ds.rowCount == 0:
		c.statusMsg = "Part id %d not found." % recId
		log.warn("SPIKE PartsStock Detail: id %d not found" % recId); return
	def gs(col):
		val = ds.getValueAt(0, col)
		return val if val is not None else ""
	def gi(col):
		val = ds.getValueAt(0, col)
		return int(val) if val is not None else 0
	def gid(col):
		val = ds.getValueAt(0, col)
		return int(val) if val is not None else None
	c.form_partNumber = gs("VC_PART_NUMBER"); c.form_partsName = gs("VC_PARTS_NAME")
	c.form_supplierId = gid("IN_SUPPLIER_ID"); c.form_logisticsId = gid("IN_LOGISTICS_ID")
	c.form_sizeId = gid("IN_SIZE_ID"); c.form_renbanId = gid("IN_RENBAN_ID")
	c.form_partTypeId = gid("IN_PART_TYPE_ID")
	c.form_lineName = gs("VC_LINE_NAME") or "TUNDRA"
	c.form_kanban = gs("VC_KANBAN_NUMBER"); c.form_lotQty = gi("IN_1LOTQTY")
	# BIT_LOT_SIZE_ORDERS is stored INVERTED (order-renban memory: 0 = lot-sized TRUE).
	# Display: checkbox.selected = NOT stored.
	storedBit = ds.getValueAt(0, "BIT_LOT_SIZE_ORDERS")
	c.form_lotSizeOrders = (not bool(storedBit)) if storedBit is not None else True
	c.form_renbanCount = gi("IN_RENBAN_COUNT")
	c.form_qty = gi("IN_QTY")   # READ-ONLY display only
	c.form_leadtime = gi("IN_LEADTIME"); c.form_ltMon = gi("IN_LEADTIME_MONDAY")
	c.form_ltTue = gi("IN_LEADTIME_TUESDAY"); c.form_ltWed = gi("IN_LEADTIME_WEDNESDAY")
	c.form_ltThu = gi("IN_LEADTIME_THURSDAY"); c.form_ltFri = gi("IN_LEADTIME_FRIDAY")
	c.form_ltSat = gi("IN_LEADTIME_SATURDAY")
	c.form_shipdays = gi("IN_SHIP_DAYS"); c.form_sdMon = gi("IN_SHIP_DAYS_MONDAY")
	c.form_sdTue = gi("IN_SHIP_DAYS_TUESDAY"); c.form_sdWed = gi("IN_SHIP_DAYS_WEDNESDAY")
	c.form_sdThu = gi("IN_SHIP_DAYS_THURSDAY"); c.form_sdFri = gi("IN_SHIP_DAYS_FRIDAY")
	c.form_sdSat = gi("IN_SHIP_DAYS_SATURDAY")
	cost = ds.getValueAt(0, "MO_PART_COST")
	c.form_partCost = float(cost) if cost is not None else 0.0
	c.form_comments = gs("VC_COMMENTS")
	c.statusMsg = "Editing part %s (id %d). On-hand %d is read-only (ledger-owned)." % (c.form_partNumber, recId, c.form_qty)
	log.info("SPIKE PartsStock Detail loaded id=%d part=%s qty=%d lotSizeShown=%s" % (recId, c.form_partNumber, c.form_qty, c.form_lotSizeOrders))

props.text: Click a row to edit at right. 5 FK combos store ids/display labels; Line is a cross-DB string. On-hand is read-only (ledger-owned). Single combined view — row-select is an in-view prop write, no navigation. Site param plumbed; IG-SITE predicate commented until the Postgres phase.

config.script:
# ---- PartsStock Save (insert-or-update) ----
	# recordId==0 -> insert; >0 -> update. IN_QTY is read-only: insert sets it to 0 (SQL
	# literal), update OMITS it entirely (never overwrite the trigger-maintained balance).
	# BIT_LOT_SIZE_ORDERS is stored INVERTED: storedBit = NOT checkbox.selected.
	log = system.util.getLogger("SPIKE")
	DB = "Inventory_Spike"
	c = self.view.custom
	# ---- SERVER-SIDE WRITE GATE (M4 P15 sweep — the H3 hole-closer) ----
	# auth.requireWrite resolves the caller's roles FROM THE SESSION (gateway-side, NOT a client
	# prop) and authorizes ProductionControl|Admin, raising AuthError on deny — BEFORE any
	# system.db write. A forged client prop or an anonymous session is rejected HERE, not by the
	# UI. This closes the reintroduced legacy H3 hole (the write was previously authorized client-
	# side only). Same gate the Sites Save/Delete/New carry (gen_sites_view.py rule #1).
	import auth as A
	try:
		A.requireWrite(self.session)
	except A.AuthError, e:
		c.statusMsg = "DENIED (server-side): " + unicode(e)
		system.util.getLogger("SPIKE").warn("SPIKE PartsStock Save DENIED (server-side gate): " + unicode(e)); return
	recId = int(c.recordId or 0)
	siteId = int(c.siteId or 1)   # IG-SITE: plumbed; predicate commented (D1)

	partNo = (c.form_partNumber or "").strip()
	name = (c.form_partsName or "").strip()

	# ---- validation (client-side fast-fail; DB unique index is the backstop) ----
	if partNo == "":
		c.statusMsg = "Part number is required."
		log.info("SPIKE PartsStock save REJECTED: blank part number"); return
	if len(partNo) > 12:
		c.statusMsg = "Part number must be 12 characters or fewer."
		log.info("SPIKE PartsStock save REJECTED: code len=%d" % len(partNo)); return

	excludeId = recId if recId > 0 else 0
	chkSql = ("SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM INV_PARTS_STOCK_MST "
	          "WHERE VC_PART_NUMBER = ? AND IN_PART_ID <> ? -- IG-SITE: AND site_id = ?")
	dup = system.db.runPrepQuery(chkSql, [partNo, excludeId], DB)
	if dup.rowCount > 0 and int(dup.getValueAt(0, 0)) > 0:
		c.statusMsg = "Part number already exists."
		log.info("SPIKE PartsStock save REJECTED: dup part=%s" % partNo); return

	def ii(v):
		try:
			return int(v) if v not in (None, "") else 0
		except Exception:
			return 0
	def fid(v):
		if v in (None, "", 0):
			return None
		try:
			return int(v)
		except Exception:
			return None
	supplierId = fid(c.form_supplierId); logisticsId = fid(c.form_logisticsId)
	sizeId = fid(c.form_sizeId); renbanId = fid(c.form_renbanId); partTypeId = fid(c.form_partTypeId)
	lineName = (c.form_lineName or "TUNDRA").strip() or "TUNDRA"
	kanban = (c.form_kanban or "")
	lotQty = ii(c.form_lotQty); renbanCount = ii(c.form_renbanCount)
	# inverted lot-size flag: stored = NOT shown
	lotSizeBit = 0 if c.form_lotSizeOrders else 1
	leadtime = ii(c.form_leadtime); ltMon = ii(c.form_ltMon); ltTue = ii(c.form_ltTue); ltWed = ii(c.form_ltWed)
	ltThu = ii(c.form_ltThu); ltFri = ii(c.form_ltFri); ltSat = ii(c.form_ltSat)
	shipdays = ii(c.form_shipdays); sdMon = ii(c.form_sdMon); sdTue = ii(c.form_sdTue); sdWed = ii(c.form_sdWed)
	sdThu = ii(c.form_sdThu); sdFri = ii(c.form_sdFri); sdSat = ii(c.form_sdSat)
	try:
		partCost = float(c.form_partCost) if c.form_partCost not in (None, "") else 0.0
	except Exception:
		partCost = 0.0
	comments = (c.form_comments or "")

	audit = ("CONVERT(char(8),GETDATE(),112) "
	         "+ SUBSTRING(CONVERT(varchar,GETDATE(),114),1,2) + SUBSTRING(CONVERT(varchar,GETDATE(),114),4,2) "
	         "+ SUBSTRING(CONVERT(varchar,GETDATE(),114),7,2) + SUBSTRING(CONVERT(varchar,GETDATE(),114),10,2)")

	# data args common to insert/update (ORDER MATCHES the ? placeholders below)
	dataArgs = [partNo, name, supplierId, logisticsId, sizeId, renbanId, partTypeId, lineName,
	            kanban, lotQty, lotSizeBit, renbanCount,
	            leadtime, ltMon, ltTue, ltWed, ltThu, ltFri, ltSat,
	            shipdays, sdMon, sdTue, sdWed, sdThu, sdFri, sdSat, partCost, comments]

	try:
		if recId == 0:
			# IN_QTY literal 0 (read-only); VC_ADD (NOT NULL) audit
			insSql = ("INSERT INTO INV_PARTS_STOCK_MST "
			          "(VC_PART_NUMBER, VC_PARTS_NAME, IN_SUPPLIER_ID, IN_LOGISTICS_ID, IN_SIZE_ID, "
			          " IN_RENBAN_ID, IN_PART_TYPE_ID, VC_LINE_NAME, VC_KANBAN_NUMBER, IN_1LOTQTY, "
			          " BIT_LOT_SIZE_ORDERS, IN_RENBAN_COUNT, IN_QTY, "
			          " IN_LEADTIME, IN_LEADTIME_MONDAY, IN_LEADTIME_TUESDAY, IN_LEADTIME_WEDNESDAY, "
			          " IN_LEADTIME_THURSDAY, IN_LEADTIME_FRIDAY, IN_LEADTIME_SATURDAY, "
			          " IN_SHIP_DAYS, IN_SHIP_DAYS_MONDAY, IN_SHIP_DAYS_TUESDAY, IN_SHIP_DAYS_WEDNESDAY, "
			          " IN_SHIP_DAYS_THURSDAY, IN_SHIP_DAYS_FRIDAY, IN_SHIP_DAYS_SATURDAY, "
			          " MO_PART_COST, VC_COMMENTS, VC_ADD) "
			          "VALUES (?,?,?,?,?, ?,?,?,?,?, ?,?,0, ?,?,?,?, ?,?,?, ?,?,?,?, ?,?,?, ?,?, " + audit + "); "
			          "SELECT CAST(SCOPE_IDENTITY() AS int) AS newId")
			rs = system.db.runPrepQuery(insSql, dataArgs, DB)
			newId = int(rs.getValueAt(0, 0))
			c.statusMsg = "Inserted part %s (id %d, on-hand 0)." % (partNo, newId)
			log.info("SPIKE PartsStock INSERT ok: part=%s newId=%d qty=0" % (partNo, newId))
			c.runNonce = (c.runNonce or 0) + 1
			c.recordId = newId
		else:
			# IN_QTY OMITTED from SET; VC_LAST_UPDATE (underscore) audit
			updSql = ("UPDATE INV_PARTS_STOCK_MST SET "
			          "VC_PART_NUMBER=?, VC_PARTS_NAME=?, IN_SUPPLIER_ID=?, IN_LOGISTICS_ID=?, IN_SIZE_ID=?, "
			          "IN_RENBAN_ID=?, IN_PART_TYPE_ID=?, VC_LINE_NAME=?, VC_KANBAN_NUMBER=?, IN_1LOTQTY=?, "
			          "BIT_LOT_SIZE_ORDERS=?, IN_RENBAN_COUNT=?, "
			          "IN_LEADTIME=?, IN_LEADTIME_MONDAY=?, IN_LEADTIME_TUESDAY=?, IN_LEADTIME_WEDNESDAY=?, "
			          "IN_LEADTIME_THURSDAY=?, IN_LEADTIME_FRIDAY=?, IN_LEADTIME_SATURDAY=?, "
			          "IN_SHIP_DAYS=?, IN_SHIP_DAYS_MONDAY=?, IN_SHIP_DAYS_TUESDAY=?, IN_SHIP_DAYS_WEDNESDAY=?, "
			          "IN_SHIP_DAYS_THURSDAY=?, IN_SHIP_DAYS_FRIDAY=?, IN_SHIP_DAYS_SATURDAY=?, "
			          "MO_PART_COST=?, VC_COMMENTS=?, VC_LAST_UPDATE = " + audit + " "
			          "WHERE IN_PART_ID = ? -- IG-SITE: AND site_id = ?")
			n = system.db.runPrepUpdate(updSql, dataArgs + [recId], DB)
			c.statusMsg = "Updated part %s (%d row). On-hand untouched (ledger-owned)." % (partNo, n)
			log.info("SPIKE PartsStock UPDATE ok: id=%d part=%s rows=%d (IN_QTY omitted)" % (recId, partNo, n))
			c.runNonce = (c.runNonce or 0) + 1
	except Exception, e:
		msg = unicode(e)
		if "IX_INV_PARTS_STOCK_MST" in msg or "duplicate key" in msg.lower() or "UNIQUE" in msg.upper():
			c.statusMsg = "Part number already exists."
			log.info("SPIKE PartsStock save: unique-index backstop fired for part=%s" % partNo)
		else:
			c.statusMsg = "Save failed: %s" % msg
			log.warn("SPIKE PartsStock save FAILED: %s" % msg)

# ---- PartsStock Delete — D3 RESTRICT gate (R1-critical) ----
	# refCount counts EVERY transactional/child reference the live DELETE_PartNumber
	# trigger does NOT clean up (it only blanks assy-ratio/forecast string codes):
	#   INV_OPEN_ORDER_INF(by number), INV_REJECT_INF(by id), INV_STOCKTAKING_INF(by id),
	#   INV_PART_SHIPPING_INF(by number), INV_PART_QTY_INF(by number),
	#   INV_BREAKDOWN_FC_INF(by number). (HIST excluded per D-decision b: a part\u2019s own audit snapshot is not an external reference.)
	# Block on any non-zero total; NEVER reach the trigger while refs exist.
	log = system.util.getLogger("SPIKE")
	DB = "Inventory_Spike"
	c = self.view.custom
	# ---- SERVER-SIDE WRITE GATE (M4 P15 sweep — the H3 hole-closer) ----
	# auth.requireWrite resolves the caller's roles FROM THE SESSION (gateway-side, NOT a client
	# prop) and authorizes ProductionControl|Admin, raising AuthError on deny — BEFORE any
	# system.db write. A forged client prop or an anonymous session is rejected HERE, not by the
	# UI. This closes the reintroduced legacy H3 hole (the write was previously authorized client-
	# side only). Same gate the Sites Save/Delete/New carry (gen_sites_view.py rule #1).
	import auth as A
	try:
		A.requireWrite(self.session)
	except A.AuthError, e:
		c.statusMsg = "DENIED (server-side): " + unicode(e)
		system.util.getLogger("SPIKE").warn("SPIKE PartsStock Delete DENIED (server-side gate): " + unicode(e)); return
	recId = int(c.recordId or 0)
	partNo = (c.form_partNumber or "").strip()
	if recId == 0:
		c.statusMsg = "Nothing to delete (unsaved new record)."
		return
	refSql = ("SELECT "
	          "  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM INV_OPEN_ORDER_INF       WHERE VC_PART_NUMBER = ?) "
	          "+ (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM INV_REJECT_INF           WHERE IN_PART_ID     = ?) "
	          "+ (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM INV_STOCKTAKING_INF      WHERE IN_PART_ID     = ?) "
	          "+ (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM INV_PART_SHIPPING_INF    WHERE VC_PART_NUMBER = ?) "
	          "+ (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM INV_PART_QTY_INF         WHERE VC_PART_NUMBER = ?) "
	          "+ (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM INV_BREAKDOWN_FC_INF     WHERE VC_PART_NUMBER = ?) AS n")
	rs = system.db.runPrepQuery(refSql, [partNo, recId, recId, partNo, partNo, partNo], DB)
	n = int(rs.getValueAt(0, 0))
	log.info("SPIKE PartsStock refCount: id=%d part=%s n=%d" % (recId, partNo, n))
	if n > 0:
		c.statusMsg = ("Cannot delete part %s — still referenced by %d order/reject/stocktaking/"
		               "shipping/qty-ledger/forecast row(s). Reassign or archive those rows first.") % (partNo, n)
		log.info("SPIKE PartsStock DELETE BLOCKED: id=%d part=%s refs=%d" % (recId, partNo, n)); return
	try:
		delN = system.db.runPrepUpdate("DELETE FROM INV_PARTS_STOCK_MST WHERE IN_PART_ID = ? -- IG-SITE: AND site_id = ?", [recId], DB)
		log.info("SPIKE PartsStock DELETE ok: id=%d part=%s rows=%d" % (recId, partNo, delN))
		c.statusMsg = "Deleted part %s." % partNo
		c.form_partNumber = ""; c.form_partsName = ""
		c.form_supplierId = None; c.form_logisticsId = None; c.form_sizeId = None
		c.form_renbanId = None; c.form_partTypeId = None; c.form_lineName = "TUNDRA"
		c.form_kanban = ""; c.form_lotQty = 0; c.form_lotSizeOrders = True
		c.form_renbanCount = 0; c.form_qty = 0
